newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy looks to compensate weather-hit farmers.
newsitem.headline: Italy looks to compensate weather-hit farmers.

text.p: Italy's Minister of Agriculture Michele Pinto on Wednesday said between two and four trillion lire would be made available to compensate farmers for crop damage due from recent bad weather in central nothern Italy.
Pinto was speaking at question time in Italy's lower chamber of parliament following recent drought and frost which have affected large areas of Italy.

Italian agricultural producers' association Confagricoltura said on Tuesday the abnormal combination of drought and frost affecting large areas of Italy for the past three months had particularly hit fruit crops, but it was too soon to assess damage to cereals.
An official at the Rome-based body said frost rather than lack of rain had been the major problem for fruit crops, particularly affecting peaches and plums and to some extent kiwis and grapes.
